note: CRITICAL IDENTITY MISMATCH: the batch name 'Alcon (Swati Spentose Pvt. Ltd)' conflates two unrelated companies. Swati Spentose Pvt. Ltd is a Mumbai API/steroid manufacturer; the legal name supplied, ALCON LABORATORIES (INDIA) PRIVATE LIMITED (3rd Floor Crescent-4, Prestige Shantiniketan, Whitefield), is the Indian eye-care subsidiary of Alcon/Novartis. All shipment evidence found belongs to the Alcon entity, NOT to Swati Spentose — no shipment record for Swati Spentose was located in this batch. HS codes: declared 292419/293399/294200/300439 (bulk organic chemicals/APIs) do NOT match the observed trade, which is finished ophthalmic devices and lenses under HS 90185090, 90213900, 90013000. Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground — the company stays in the base and the code should be corrected to the factual 9018/9021/9001 range with verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Role: this entity is an importer/distributor of Alcon group products into India (28,041 records, 75 counterparties, latest 2026-02-28), i.e. manufacturer_trader within the group, not a chemical trader. Export side is only weakly evidenced (aggregated buyer list, no dated outbound B/L) — treat as confirmed at group level but flag that no single dated export record was seen. Domestic turnover: null, not public in reachable sources. Recommend re-verification of which legal entity is actually intended before any use.
